events.title: 35-year-old midfielder 고든 스트라컨 is awarded an OBE .
크리스털 팰리스, the 1990 FA Cup finalists, suffer a shock third round exit from the competition when they lose 1–0 at 하틀리풀 유나이티드 .
스컨소프 유나이티드 manager Bill Green becomes the first Football League managerial casualty of 1993 when he is sacked in favour of Richard Money .
Eighteen months after leaving 맨체스터 유나이티드 for 애스턴 빌라, Les Sealey returns to Old Trafford on a free transfer.
블랙번 로버스 sign Swedish midfielder Patrik Andersson from Malmö FF for £800,000.

The first Premier League games of 1993 see 맨체스터 유나이티드 go top of the Premier League on goal difference with a 4–1 home win over 토트넘 홋스퍼, although they are still level on points with 애스턴 빌라, who beat 리버풀 2–1 at Anfield, and a 노리치 시티 side who play tomorrow. Division One leaders 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 beat 브리스틀 시티 2–1 at Ashton Gate.
노리치 시티 miss the chance to regain their lead of the Premier League, losing 1–0 to 셰필드 웬즈데이 at Hillsborough.
리버풀 suffer a shock FA Cup exit in the third round replay, losing 2–0 at home to Division Two side 볼턴 원더러스 .
노츠 카운티 , bottom of Division One and in danger of a second successive relegation, sack manager Neil Warnock .

노리치 시티 draw 1–1 at home to Coventry and go back to the top of the Premier League. 노팅엄 포리스트's survival hopes are boosted with a 3–0 home win over 첼시. 블랙번 로버스 get their title bid back on track with a 1–0 at Oldham.
애스턴 빌라 go top of the Premier League with a 5–1 home win over 미들즈브러.
The lead of the Premier League changes for the third day running when 맨체스터 유나이티드 triumph 3–1 over QPR at Loftus Road to top the table on goal difference.
Denis Smith is sacked after less than ten months as manager of 브리스틀 시티.

블랙번 로버스 sign Norway defender Henning Berg from Lillestrøm in a £400,000 deal. There is midweek drama in the Premier League as Berg's new club lose 5–2 at home to a Coventry side who are now fifth in the table just five points off the top. 미들즈브러 jump clear of the relegation zone with a 2–1 home win over 사우샘프턴. Oldham's survival bid is dented by a 1–0 home defeat to 맨체스터 시티, who climb four places to sixth. 윔블던 miss the chance to climb out of the drop zone, losing 3–1 at home to 에버턴.

The top three sides in the Premier League all achieve home wins. 맨체스터 유나이티드 beat 노팅엄 포리스트 2–0, 애스턴 빌라 beat 셰필드 유나이티드 3–1 and 노리치 시티 battle it out to beat 크리스털 팰리스 4–2. A West London derby at Loftus Road sees 첼시 and QPR draw 1–1. 입스위치 타운 beat 토트넘 홋스퍼 2–0 at White Hart Lane .

노리치 시티 return to the top of the Premier League with a 1–0 win over 에버턴 at Goodsion Park , thanks to their local rivals 입스위치 타운 beating 맨체스터 유나이티드 2–1 at Portman Road and 애스턴 빌라 losing 2–0 at 사우샘프턴. 입스위치 타운 are now fourth in the table, six points off the top and surprisingly emerging as title contenders for the first time in 11 years. 블랙번 로버스 continue to feel the absence of Alan Shearer as they lose 3–2 to 맨체스터 시티 at Maine Road. Oldham fall to the bottom of the table after 노팅엄 포리스트 overhaul them with a 2–0 victory at the City Ground . 윔블던 climb out of the relegation zone with a 2–0 win at Coventry. 리버풀, who didn't play today, are now a lowly 17th in the table, but have games in hand over everyone else in the Premier League.

January ends with 노리치 시티 still top of the Premiership, but with their lead over 맨체스터 유나이티드 now down to a single point. 애스턴 빌라 and 입스위치 타운 are continuing to keep up the pressure, but 블랙번 로버스 have slumped to fifth place. 노팅엄 포리스트 and 올덤 애슬레틱 hold the bottom two places, with 셰필드 유나이티드 still occupying the final relegation position. The Division One promotion chase is still led by runaway leaders 뉴캐슬 유나이티드, whose nearest challenge is from a 웨스트햄 유나이티드 side who are 11 points behind them with a game in hand. 밀월, 트랜미어 로버스, 포츠머스 and 레스터 시티 occupy the playoff zone. The division's bottom two clubs, 루턴 타운 and 노츠 카운티, are under serious threat of a second successive relegation, joined in the bottom three by a 사우스엔드 유나이티드 side who spent much of last season challenging for promotion to the Premier League. The only league action of the day sees 리버풀 win 1–0 at 아스널 to climb five places up to 12th in the Premier League. 아스널 are now 10th in the league after briefly topping the table in November, but are still in contention for the FA Cup and League Cup.
